title: Retained contributions, exact withdrawal and evidence
statement: Re-evaluating the remaining identified contributions uses the existing meet operation on a fixed form and context. The aggregate alone need not identify that remainder, even on a distributive two-element chain. A reading identifies evidence; mathematical form does not confer admission authority.
assumptions: Fixed form, coordinates and effective context
Complete identified live contribution family for recomputation
Removing one identified contribution, not all equal values
Authority and widening rules are decided by the consuming policy
boundary: The published withdrawsExactly API checks a finite scale property. It is not an inverse of an arbitrary lossy aggregate. Associative and commutative aggregation alone proves neither cancellation nor authorization.
status: conditional interpretation and finite counterexample; no existing algebra or judge changed
runtimeAPI: No new runtime export; these contracts and their native finite witnesses extend the admitted theory without duplicating the engine.
